hero.title: Own a Share of Real-World Property
hero.text: Explore vetted, income-producing properties and choose the ones you want to own a piece of, starting from $10.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of city apartment towers at sunset

items.question: What do I actually own?
items.answer: Each property is held by its own company. Buying tokens gives you a share of that company and of the rent it collects.

items.question: How are rental payments made?
items.answer: Rent is collected by the property manager. After costs and reserves, the remainder is paid out to holders, usually every month.

items.question: How are properties selected?
items.answer: Every property is inspected and its finances are reviewed before it's listed. Look for the verified badge next to a property's name.

items.question: Can I sell my share later?
items.answer: Yes. Each property's page explains how and when its tokens can be transferred or sold.
